app_archetype: Hybrid Fullstack - Stripe & Razorpay Grade SaaS Product Portal with Modern Minimalist Admin Console

design_philosophy.vision: Stripe-level clarity meets Razorpay's effortless checkout confidence. Zero purple AI gimmicks, zero muddy glassmorphism, zero generic centered cards. Clean architectural white surfaces, deep Veritech navy structural anchors, precise high-contrast electric brand blue highlights, and ultra-crisp tabular micro-layouts.
design_philosophy.brand_alignment: Preserves exact Veritech.AI brand geometry (Dark Navy #0F172A text, Electric Cyan-Blue #2563EB accent square icon and .AI affix). The UI elevates interns' transition into certified AI & Software professionals.

logo_integration.aspect_ratio_preservation: strict - object-contain, never stretched or recolored
logo_integration.header_placement: Left-aligned with subtle vertical divider separating product identifier: 'Certificate Portal'
logo_integration.usage_rule: Strictly render with clean light background (#FFFFFF or #F8FAFC). Never invert, skew, or place over noisy gradients.

theme_strategy.surface_tone: Warm crisp slate-neutral (#F8FAFC canvas with pure #FFFFFF elevation cards)
theme_strategy.contrast_standard: WCAG AAA & APCA compliant high-contrast dark navy typography against pale surfaces

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-[1.15]

spacing_and_radii.spacing_scale: 8px baseline grid (p-2: 8px, p-4: 16px, p-6: 24px, p-8: 32px, p-12: 48px, p-16: 64px)

selected_images.usage_placement: Landing page credentials banner or testimonial backing with subtle overlay

selected_images.description: Female software engineer coding in AI development environment
selected_images.usage_placement: Hero split-screen showcase / internship program credibility badge

selected_images.description: Confident intern graduate holding certified document
selected_images.usage_placement: Review page reassurance sidebar or Certificate verification preview

header_nav.primary_cta: bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm transition-all

payment_modal_and_razorpay.simulation_drawer: Razorpay-grade trusted modal overlay with locked security badges, auto-calculated GST breakdown (inclusive or itemized), UPI options (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), NetBanking, and Credit/Debit cards.

receipt_style_card.top_accent_strip: h-2 w-full bg-emerald-500 absolute top-0 left-0
receipt_style_card.notch_cutouts: Subtle dashed perforation divider line separating ticket header and transaction breakdown
receipt_style_card.qr_code_area: Clean border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center

page_1_landing_hero.title: Veritech.AI Certificate Registration Portal
page_1_landing_hero.layout: Sticky glass navbar + Asymmetric hero with verified statistics, clear value props (Fast Verification, Tamper-proof QR, Globally Recognized), instant 'Register Now' & 'Track Application' action buttons.

page_2_intern_registration_form.title: Step 1: Intern & Internship Details
form_sections: Personal Information (Full Name, Personal Email, Phone Number, College / University, Degree, Branch/Specialization, Graduation Year)
Internship Information (Internship ID / Roll No, Domain / Role [AI/ML, Data Science, Fullstack Web Dev, Cloud Architecture, etc.], Start Date, End Date, Mentor Name)
Certificate Preference (Name on Certificate, Delivery Address if applicable)
Intern Declaration Checkbox with legal verification consent

page_3_review_details.title: Step 2: Review Registration Data
page_3_review_details.layout: Two-column inspection: Left column grouped cards with quick inline edit modals; Right column summary card with intern ID preview and declaration status.

page_4_select_certificate_duration.title: Step 3: Select Certificate Duration & Plan
page_4_select_certificate_duration.layout: 4-card pricing tier (1M ₹99, 2M ₹149, 3M ₹199 Popular, 6M ₹499) + Live Dynamic Order Summary Card + Promo code input + Razorpay Checkout Trigger.

page_5_payment_processing_razorpay.title: Razorpay Payment Gateway Trigger
page_5_payment_processing_razorpay.flow: Mock/Sandbox Razorpay modal supporting instant success test button, UPI ID test, and simulated failure test for robust QA testing.

page_6_payment_success.title: Step 4: Payment Confirmed & Registration Successful
page_6_payment_success.layout: Clean receipt card with transaction reference (TXN-VERI-XXXX), Intern ID, Certificate Duration, Download PDF Receipt button, and View Status button.

page_7_payment_failed.title: Payment Unsuccessful
page_7_payment_failed.layout: Informative recovery card with error diagnostic message, 'Retry Payment' primary button, and 'Contact Support' fallback.

page_8_status_lookup.title: Track Registration & Certificate Verification
page_8_status_lookup.layout: Instant lookup by Intern ID or Email with interactive timeline tracker (Registered -> Payment Verified -> Under Admin Review -> Certificate Issued).

page_9_admin_login.title: Veritech Admin Secure Console
page_9_admin_login.layout: Centered clean auth card with demo credentials auto-fill button (admin@veritech.ai / admin123).

page_10_admin_dashboard_kpis.title: Admin Overview & Performance Metrics
page_10_admin_dashboard_kpis.charts: Revenue over time line chart + Registration domain distribution donut chart.

universal_testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, tab, filter, and critical status badge MUST include data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the uploaded logo at /veritech-logo.png or create an identical high-res SVG component if image loading fails.
Do NOT use generic purple gradients or AI chat visuals. Use Stripe/Razorpay high-trust fintech and enterprise SaaS styling.
Keep Light theme as default with pure white cards, #F8FAFC canvas, and #0F172A primary navy text.
All form steps must preserve state into localStorage/backend so interns never lose entered information.
Implement simulated Razorpay modal with seamless test payment modes (Success / Failure) to ensure 100% demo fidelity without requiring real bank credentials.
